description: The space's drafts as the user sees them: text, platform, status, tags, planned date, media (image/video), the post it quotes, schedule state, and the reviewer's score / verdict / one-line fix. FREE. Use it to present drafts one by one, to read back how drafts scored, and to pull a slice of the content plan: filter by tag (e.g. a campaign week), platform, or planned date window (planned_from / planned_to, YYYY-MM-DD; orders by planned date). status: active (default — pending + reviewed + staged), pending, reviewed, staged (approved, awaiting publish), scheduled (already in the user's scheduler — read-only), discarded, all (everything but discarded). counts are space-wide totals. tags_in_use lists every tag the space uses (most-used first) — check it before tagging a series. Call get_content_draft for one draft's per-axis score and earlier versions.

planned_from.description: Planned on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO time.

planned_to.description: Planned on or before this date (whole day) or ISO time.

platform.description: Only this platform label (exact), e.g. "Lior X".

tag.description: Only drafts with this tag (case-insensitive), e.g. "Communities week".

name: get_content_queue
title: Read the content queue with scores
